title: Membrane Potential
description: Let potassium leak out through its channels and the inside of the cell goes negative, until the voltage holds it back: Nernst. Unlocks Ion Channel Membranes.

puzzle.goal: Ions of charge z are at c outside and q inside. Write the voltage E (in mV, at body heat) that holds them in balance.
puzzle.name: Nernst equation
puzzle.ask: Find E for potassium: z = @{z}, c = @{c} and q = @{q}.
puzzle.method: Diffusion pushes ions down their gradient, ln(c/q) times RT; the voltage pushes back zF E. They balance at RT/zF ln(c/q).
